claim: Documentary re-qualification of retained NativeStack2604 foundation observations on 2026-10-05. The last fully adjudicated 80-slot baseline remains 30/80 (37.5%) on 2026-10-04. The co-op supplied a provisional 40/80 (50%) scenario and a conditional 44/80 (55%) scenario. Four fresh token-slot judgments disagree. The retained sources do not yet supply a complete independently reviewed 80-slot join or the ten promoted slots deriving 40; neither scenario is published as a verified aggregate or upstream acceptance. Native stage results, limited client-leg reviews, intentional dispositions and structural publication checks remain separate.
limitations: All 2026-10-05 readiness scenarios remain provisional until their per-slot derivation and independent review are retained. The 2026-10-04 baseline is historical; it is not a new host run.

The 40/80 numerator is supplied in the lane brief, not derived from an available fresh 80-slot adjudication. A post-install exit of zero, a version check, a model READY label and a Codex-only use check do not close the PR #700 whole-slot contract.

The conditional 44/80 assumes READY adjudications for token-efficiency/code-index, command-output, output-compression and repo-packing. Opus judged these READY; GPT judged them PARTIAL. Their missing native or upstream acceptance remains open.

The first post-install census has 80 rows: 50 exit-zero, 28 skipped and two failures. The later raw census has a duplicate skill-authoring attempt; attempt rows are not distinct slots. Omitted stages and held slots remain in the denominator.

The later observations at 4c897418f are retained private source files, not a completed persistent co-op census in fixwave-4c897418f at publication. Sources and observation scope are inventoried by hash without copying raw session streams.

Session-analytics summary claims conflict with retained rerun exit-code files; later output files lack complete exit/time siblings. Alerting exit zero coexists with an explicit needs_user/sink disposition. Preserve these attempts and reported claims separately; neither implies READY.

The fixwave-defects and currency lanes were in progress at the publication boundary. No slot is declared repaired, installed or accepted by their planned changes. Their future receipts require a separate follow-up.

This publication does not execute upstream tests, host acceptance commands, provider requests, GPU checks or broker operations. Structural checks verify the documents and generators, not capability acceptance.
